claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k production baseline frozen with 6/8 adversarial gate PASS (JP=0.5925); dense complementary views validated at 144k/22yr partial cohort only; full 174k dense validation BLOCKED on corpus lane
evidence_summary: Three identical verification runs (05:13, 05:14, 05:32, 05:34:26, 05:34:30, 05:34:34) confirm benchmark determinism fix (sorted group iteration). Production baseline cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 passes both adversarial gates (JP=0.5925 > 0.5, LangDom=0.3481 < 0.85). regeste_tfidf (JP=0.403) and outcome_tfidf (JP=0.261) fail jurist gate. Cross-environment discrepancy (7/8 vs 6/8 PASS) honestly disclosed and attributed to k-NN tie-breaking across numpy/sklearn versions. Dense complementary acceptance criteria defined for 5 views, validated at max available scale (144k/22yr) with explicit qualifications. Negative findings preserved (OOS ceiling ~0.53, v18 hierarchy 0.65, citation heritage recall@10 0.0066). Data blockers identified (BGE/bger ID mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction, GPU). Recommendation to stop same-question cycles is appropriate.
